description: Send a Plumbline order draft once the buyer has said to: the first send records the request (the firm offer with its exact price and terms hash is emailed to the buyer and appears in the app when ready; promise no time); a later send of a changed list records a revision of the same request and declines the offer for the earlier list as replaced. Name the revision the buyer saw: a draft that changed since is not sent. Needs the buyer's email on the first send (where the offer and receipt go). This places no order: the buyer accepts the firm offer separately.

confirm.description: The buyer asked to send it

from_app.description: Set only by the app itself

revision.description: The draft revision the buyer saw and asked to send

token.description: The draft's private token (also the receipt token of every request sent from it); keep it private

name: send_order_draft
title: Send the order draft as a request
